name: lifelink-app
description: LifeLink Android app (Capacitor wrapper around the LifeLink web app)

scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/android-setup.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:www && node scripts/android-setup.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:unix: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
